guia.what: A compact label for statuses, categories, or counts. It has a subtle or solid fill (`fill-subtle`, `fill-solid`), a status dot with an optional pulse (`data-badge-dot`, `is-pulse`), an icon before or after (`ts badge-prefix`, `ts badge-suffix`), and it can be a link (`<a class="ts badge" href>`).
whenUse: Showing something’s status in one word, like “Active,” “Beta,” or “Expired.”
Placing a count or a category next to a heading or a row.
You want it to read at a glance, without being a control.
whenAvoid: The user needs to remove it or click it to filter → `tag`.
The message needs more than two words → `note`.
It’s an action, not a label → `button`.
dos: The text has to state the status. Color alone isn’t enough.
Use the dot to reinforce a live status, never to replace the label.
donts: Don’t use it as a button. If it needs to be clicked, it’s something else.
Don’t put sentences in it. A long badge stops being compact.
